# gcore_cloud_gpu_virtual_cluster (Data Source)

GPU virtual clusters provide managed virtual GPU servers with auto-scaling for parallel computation workloads.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gcore_cloud_gpu_virtual_cluster" "example_cloud_gpu_virtual_cluster" {
  project_id = 1
  region_id = 7
  cluster_id = "1aaaab48-10d0-46d9-80cc-85209284ceb4"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster unique identifier
- `find_one_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by))
- `project_id` (Number) Project ID
- `region_id` (Number) Region ID

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Cluster creation date time
- `flavor` (String) Cluster flavor name
- `has_pending_changes` (Boolean) True if any server in the cluster has pending (not yet applied) settings changes
- `id` (String) Cluster unique identifier
- `name` (String) Cluster name
- `servers_count` (Number) Cluster servers count
- `servers_ids` (List of String) List of cluster nodes
- `servers_settings` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers_settings))
- `status` (String) Cluster status
Available values: "active", "creating", "degraded", "deleting", "error", "rebooting", "rebuilding", "resizing", "shutoff".
- `tags` (Attributes List) List of key-value tags associated with the resource. A tag is a key-value pair that can be associated with a resource, enabling efficient filtering and grouping for better organization and management. Some tags are read-only and cannot be modified by the user. Tags are also integrated with cost reports, allowing cost data to be filtered based on tag keys or values. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) Cluster update date time

<a id="nestedatt--find_one_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `find_one_by`

Optional:

- `created_at` (Attributes) Filter by creation time (UTC), e.g. `created_at[gte]=2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by--created_at))
- `flavor` (Attributes) Filter by flavor (case-insensitive), e.g. `flavor[prefix]=g3-`, `flavor[exact]=g3-ai-32-192-1500-l40s-48-1`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by--flavor))
- `ids` (List of String) Return only clusters with these IDs, e.g. `ids=<id1>&ids=<id2>`.
- `name` (Attributes) Filter by name (case-insensitive), e.g. `name[contains]=gpu`, `name[prefix]=prod-`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by--name))
- `servers_count` (Attributes) Filter by node count, e.g. `servers_count[gte]=2`, `servers_count[gte]=2&servers_count[lt]=8`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by--servers_count))
- `tag_key` (Attributes) Filter by tag key regardless of value, e.g. `tag_key[contains]=team`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by--tag_key))
- `tag_value` (Attributes) Filter by tag value regardless of key, e.g. `tag_value[prefix]=prod`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by--tag_value))
- `tags` (Map of List of String) Filter by exact tag key-value pairs, e.g. `tags[env]=prod&tags[team]=core`. Repeat a key to match any of several values for it, e.g. `tags[env]=prod&tags[env]=dev`. Values for one key are ORed, different keys are ANDed; values match case-insensitively.
- `updated_at` (Attributes) Filter by last-change time (UTC), e.g. `updated_at[gte]=2026-06-01T00:00:00Z`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by--updated_at))

### Nested Schema for `servers_settings`

Read-Only:

- `file_shares` (Attributes List) List of file shares mounted across the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers_settings--file_shares))
- `interfaces` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers_settings--interfaces))
- `security_groups` (Attributes List, Deprecated) Deprecated. Deduplicated union of security groups across all interfaces; the actual assignment may differ per interface. Use `interfaces[].security_groups` for the authoritative per-interface list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers_settings--security_groups))
- `ssh_key_name` (String) SSH key name
- `user_data` (String) Optional custom user data
- `volumes` (Attributes List) List of volumes (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers_settings--volumes))

<a id="nestedatt--servers_settings--file_shares"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers_settings.file_shares`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the file share in UUID format.
- `mount_path` (String) Absolute mount path inside the system where the file share will be mounted.


<a id="nestedatt--servers_settings--interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers_settings.interfaces`

Read-Only:

- `floating_ip` (Attributes) Floating IP config for this subnet attachment (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers_settings--interfaces--floating_ip))
- `ip_address` (String) Fixed IP address
- `ip_family` (String) Which subnets should be selected: IPv4, IPv6, or use dual stack.
Available values: "dual", "ipv4", "ipv6".
- `name` (String) Interface name
- `network_id` (String) Network ID the subnet belongs to. Port will be plugged in this network
- `security_groups` (Attributes List) Resolved security groups applied to this interface. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers_settings--interfaces--security_groups))
- `subnet_id` (String) Port is assigned an IP address from this subnet
- `type` (String) Available values: "external", "subnet", "any_subnet".
